{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify the six QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

# Identify refunded orders
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']

# Create a mask for valid orders: exclude refunded and QA orders
valid_mask = (~df['status'].isin(['refunded'])) & (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)

# Apply mask
df_clean = df[valid_mask].copy()

# Compute conversion rates by channel and segment
conv_by_channel_segment = df_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack(level='customer_segment')

# Compute segment counts by channel
channel_segment_counts = df_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment']).size().unstack(level='customer_segment')

# Compute weights (proportion of each segment within each channel)
channel_weights = channel_segment_counts.div(channel_segment_counts.sum(axis=1), axis=0)

# Compute weighted conversion rate per channel
weighted_conv = (conv_by_channel_segment * channel_weights).sum(axis=1)

# Compute the difference (email - paid_search)
diff = weighted_conv['email'] - weighted_conv['paid_search']

# Print all required numbers
print(f"Number of valid orders after filtering: {len(df_clean)}")
print(f"Conversion rate by channel (raw): email = {weighted_conv['email']:.6f}, paid_search = {weighted_conv['paid_search']:.6f}")
print("Conversion rates by channel and segment:")
print(conv_by_channel_segment)
print("Segment counts by channel:")
print(channel_segment_counts)
print("Weighted conversion rates (stratified by segment):")
print(weighted_conv)
print(f"Difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search): {diff:.6f}")"}
